_comment: What a correct run over demo/corpus.json must achieve. Scored, not asserted for equality — the consolidator is model-backed and its wording will vary. What must not vary is whether it found the right things.

triple.description: One ask arriving as two mails, a chat, and a calendar invite body.

buried_commitment.description: The operator promised revised numbers by Friday, deep in a thread.

invented_deadline.description: A chat message says 'soon-ish'. Nothing may carry a date from it.

polite_trap.description: Loud newsletter, asks nothing. Must rank below anything real.

high_risk.description: An overdue invoice for real money from an external party.

split.description: Dana's 'cancel it entirely' shares a thread with Priya's ask.
